case_title: SKYLINE REALTY, INC., A CALIF CORPORATION vs. MCNEIL, IDA et al

docket_entries.description: APPLICATION FOR WAIVER OF 985.(J) CRC REPORTERS FEES FILED BY DEFENDANT MCNEIL, IDA ORDER GRANTING WAIVER OF 985.(J) CRC REPORTERS FEES

MEMO TO SET FOR JURY TRIAL FILED BY PLAINTIFF SKYLINE REALTY, INC., A CALIF CORPORATION SETTLEMENT CONFERENCE SET FOR NOV-08-1993 AT 02:00 PM IN DEPT 03 SET FOR JURY TRIAL ON NOV-15-1993 AT 09:00 AM IN DEPT 206 NOTICE OF TIME AND PLACE OF TRIAL FILED

3:05 P.M. C/C FOR SETTLEMENT CONFERENCE. ALL PARTIES AND COUNSEL PRESENT. GEORGE COLBERT, JUDGE PRO TEM. JOHN LEWIS, REPORTER. CASE SETTLED BY STIPULATED JUDGMENT IN FAVOR OF PLAINTIFF AND AGAINST DEFENDANT IDA MCNEIL FOR RESTITUTION AND POSSESSION OF THE PREMISE LOCATED AT 935 GEARY STREET #707 SAN FRANCISCO, CA. AND FOR FORFEITURE OF THE LEASE. JUDGMENT TO INCLUDE TENANTS, SUBTENANTS AND NAMED CLAIMANTS. WRIT MAY ISSUE FORTHWITH; STAY PHYSICAL EVICTION TO 11:59 P.M. ON 12/5/93. NO FURTHER STAYS WITH RESPECT TO THIS ACTION NOR APPLICATION FOR RELIEF FROM JUDGMENT. IF DEFENDANT RETURNS POSSESSION OF THE SUBJECT PREMISE BEFORE 11:59 P.M. ON 12/5/93, PLAINTIFF SHALL VACATE AND DISMISS THE JUDGMENT IF DEFENDANT SUPPLIES COUNSEL FOR PLAINTIFF WITH FORMS FOR SUCH PURPOSE. PERSONAL PROPERTY OF DEFENDANT LEFT ON THE PREMISE SHALL BE DEEMED ABANDONED AND PLAINTIFF MAY DISPOSE OF IT AS IT DEEMS FIT. PLAINTIFF SHALL RETAIN ALL DEPOSITS FOR THE PREMISE.
STIPULATION FOR ENTRY OF JUDGMENT, SIGNED BY ALL PARTIES,

THE COURT ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT MCNEIL, IDA THE RESTITUTION AND POSSESSION OF THE PREMISES: 935 GEARY STREET #707 SAN FRANCISCO, CA $1,400.00 RENT, TOTAL JUDGMENT $1,400.00, STAYED UNTIL DEC-05-1993, LEASE FORFEITED, WRIT FORTHWITH, STAY PHYSICAL EVICTION TO 12/5/93. THIS JUDGMENT TO BE VACATED IF DEFENDANT RETURNS POSSESSION OF PREMISE AT OR BEFORE 11/5/93 11:59 P.M IN WHICH EVENT THE ACTION SHALL BE DISMISSED WITHOUT PREJUDICE. SEE JUDGMENT AT LENGTH FOR FURTHER DETAILS.
